---
title: "haram_ball"
format: html
---


```{r}
ggplot(df_main, aes(x = stat, y = total, fill = match)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = total),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Football vs Haram Ball",
    subtitle = "Arsenal 1–1 Atlético de Madrid vs PSG 5–4 Bayern Munich",
    x = "",
    y = "Total"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, face = "bold")
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(df_main$total, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2)


```


```{R}

ggplot(df_main, aes(x = stat, y = total, fill = match)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  
  # Better labels
  geom_text(
    aes(label = total),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E41A1C", "#083D77")) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Total Football vs Haram Ball",
    subtitle = "Arsenal 1–1 Atlético vs PSG 5–4 Bayern",
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    
    # Titles
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    
    # Clean axes
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    
    # Remove clutter
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  
  ylim(0, max(df_main$total) * 1.15)

```


```{R}

ggplot(fpg, aes(x = match, y = fouls_per_goal, fill = match)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.45) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(fouls_per_goal, 1)),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E41A1C", "#083D77")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 30),
    breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Haram Ball Index",
    subtitle = "Fouls per goal: Arsenal vs Atlético & PSG vs Bayern",
    x = "",
    y = "Fouls per goal"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```
